[LLSU.14.1] Synthetic names, the `$`-prefixed names the compiler and engine
make for themselves ([LLEX.10.6.1]). Author code can't produce these; dialects that disable this
category reject rule files containing any feature that
would require synthetic identifiers (essentially:
everything with any desugaring).

| Name | Explanation | Refactor hint |
|---|---|---|
| `synthetic_identifiers` | compiler-generated `$`-prefixed names (for desugaring and internal machinery) | disabling effectively disables most of the language; not meaningfully avoidable |
